testcase.name: Scenario: Inspect and dismisses file-type choices: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-document-opening-source/features/application/document-opening/document-opening.feature:283:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Inspect and dismisses file-type choices ✔ Given the Open dialog is open in the MCAD Software ✔ And a saved part is selected with its name and preview displayed ✔ And `fixtures/cad/extrusion/extrusion-rect-8mm.opd` is selected with the native document filter active ✔ When the user opens the file-type filter list ✔ Then the list offers a combined native-document filter ✔ And it includes separate filters for assemblies, drawings, parts and presentations ✔ And additional file-format filters are visible ✔ When the user dismisses the list without choosing a different filter ✔ Then the previous file-type filter remains displayed ✔ And the selected part name and preview remain displayed
